I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live sports schedules, so I can’t tell you which specific IPL fixture is happening “today” right now.  

If you’re looking for the most accurate and up‑to‑date lineup:

| Where | How |
|-------|-----|
| **Official IPL Website** (`www.iplt20.com`) | Go to *Fixtures & Results* → select your local time zone (IST) to see all games scheduled for the day. |
| **ESPN Cricinfo** (`www.espncricinfo.com`) | Navigate to *IPL* → *Schedule*. It lists dates, teams, venues, start times, and TV/network details. |
| **Sports Apps** (Hotstar, SonyLIV, WillowTV, ESPN App) | These apps usually show a calendar view of upcoming fixtures along with push notifications when a match starts. |
| **Social Media / Twitter** | Follow @IPLT20 or @IPL_TV for quick updates and last‑minute changes. |

### Quick Tips  
1. **Check IST:** All official timings are given in India Standard Time (UTC+5:30). If you’re outside India, convert accordingly.  
2. **Match Day vs Match Weekends:** Most IPL games run from Thursday through Sunday each week—so look at those days first.  
3. **Live Streaming Links:** Hotstar (India), SonyLIV (outside India), and WillowTV (US/Australia) typically stream all matches live.  

Feel free to let me know the season/year you’re interested in (e.g., 2024, 2025, etc.), and I can give you more context about that particular tournament’s structure!
